en.headline: Smoke from container office at Prince of Wales Hospital redevelopment site; no injuries
en.dek: Firefighters raised the alarm to No. 2 after thick smoke was reported from a worksite container office in Sha Tin around 9.47pm; the blaze was under control within half an hour.
body: Thick smoke rose from a container office inside the Prince of Wales Hospital redevelopment site in Sha Tin late on Monday, prompting multiple calls to police at about 9.47pm.

The Fire Services Department initially graded the incident as a No. 1 alarm and later upgraded it to No. 2, deploying a breathing-apparatus team and hose lines. A stop-mobilisation message was issued at 10.16pm. Initial checks found no one injured.
Clips shared online showed dark smoke near the site gate and haze along nearby streets opposite the hospital. The Hospital Authority was checking the incident.

zh.headline: 威爾斯親王醫院重建地盤貨櫃辦公室冒濃煙 無人受傷
zh.dek: 周一晚約9時47分沙田威院重建地盤有濃煙冒出，消防由一級改列二級火警，出動煙帽隊開喉灌救，約半小時後停止動員，初步無人受傷。
body: 周一晚約9時47分，警方接獲多人報案，指沙田威爾斯親王醫院重建地盤有濃煙冒出。
消防起初列為一級火警，其後改列二級，出動煙帽隊及開喉灌救，晚上10時16分發出停止動員訊息。據報起火位置為地盤內一個貨櫃辦公室，初步無人受傷。
網上片段可見地盤大閘附近有黑煙，附近街道亦受濃煙影響。醫管局正跟進事件。
